Fold-safe target encoding of interaction columns uses K-fold OOF encoding to avoid leakage, with frequency encoding for categoricals. Base learners are LightGBM (native categoricals plus TE numerics), CatBoost (native categoricals), and an embedding MLP with focal loss (embeddings, batchnorm/dropout MLP, cosine LR schedule). 5-fold stratified CV generates OOF probabilities for each model, which are combined via a LogisticRegression stacker, and a decision threshold is tuned on OOF accuracy. Models are refit on the full training set (3 seeds for LGBM, MLP; 3 for CatBoost), bundled with FE, category maps, label map, stacker, and threshold, and saved with joblib. Prediction loads the bundle, refits nothing, blends base model probabilities through the persisted stacker, applies the threshold, and maps predictions back to original labels, outputting row_id,prediction."}
